macro_cross_check: Computed 502 cal / 38.8 g protein / 51 g carbs per serving over 6 servings, against the source's published 477 / 40 / 57. Calories +5.2%, protein -3.0%, both well inside the bar, so the grams are sound - in particular the 3 lb squash reads as 3 lb of prepped flesh rather than whole squash, which is what makes the calories agree. LOUD FLAG: my computed protein of 38.8 g sits just UNDER this run's 40 g floor even though the source publishes exactly 40. The recipe is genuinely borderline rather than wrong, and it turns on the pork row - I used the lean-and-fat RAW cut (21.3 g protein per 100 g); the trimmed lean-only cut would carry it clear. I am not rejecting on this; the band gate should rule with the number in front of it.
